description:
Every claim we checked for a project against independent data: the reconciliations
    (reported figure vs our independent value, method, verdict, evidence link), metric
    flags, and emission honesty. Carries the verdict vocabulary, assessment levels and
    `_rule` verbatim so a caller reports 'not-assessed' honestly and never invents a
    'verified'. Optional verdict filter (e.g. 'inflated', 'outdated') narrows the rows.
    Paged at 25 rows: when next_offset is set, call again with offset=next_offset.
name: get_integrity_verdicts
